---- MODULE Zab ----
EXTENDS ZabDefs

\* BEGIN AGENT HELPERS

LOCAL AGFinite == INSTANCE FiniteSetTheorems

AGRoles ==
    /\ state \in [Server -> {LOOKING, FOLLOWING, LEADING}]
    /\ zabState \in [Server ->
          {ELECTION, DISCOVERY, SYNCHRONIZATION, BROADCAST}]

LEMMA AGTxnReflexive == \A t : TxnEqual(t, t)
BY SMTT("r1") DEF TxnEqual, ZxidEqual

LEMMA AGTxnSymmetric == \A s, t : TxnEqual(s, t) => TxnEqual(t, s)
BY SMTT("r1") DEF TxnEqual, ZxidEqual

LEMMA AGTxnTransitive ==
    \A r, s, t : TxnEqual(r, s) /\ TxnEqual(s, t) => TxnEqual(r, t)
BY SMTT("r1") DEF TxnEqual, ZxidEqual

LEMMA AGMinimumPair ==
    ASSUME NEW a \in Int, NEW b \in Int
    PROVE /\ Minimum({a, b}) \in {a, b}
          /\ Minimum({a, b}) <= a
          /\ Minimum({a, b}) <= b
<1>1. \E n \in {a, b} : \A m \in {a, b} : n <= m
  BY SMTT("r1")
<1>2. QED BY <1>1, SMTT("r1") DEF Minimum

LEMMA AGRolesInit == Init => AGRoles
BY SMTT("r1") DEF Init, InitServerVars, AGRoles

LEMMA AGRolesStep == AGRoles /\ [Next]_vars => AGRoles'
<1>1. ASSUME AGRoles, Next PROVE AGRoles'
  <2> USE <1>1
  <2>1. CASE \E i \in Server : UpdateLeader(i)
    BY <2>1, SMTT("r3") DEF AGRoles, UpdateLeader, SwitchToLeader, serverVars
  <2>2. CASE \E i \in Server : FollowLeader(i)
    BY <2>2, SMTT("r3") DEF AGRoles, FollowLeader, SwitchToLeader, SwitchToFollower, serverVars
  <2>3. CASE \E i, j \in Server : Timeout(i, j)
    BY <2>3, SMTT("r3") DEF AGRoles, Timeout, FollowerShutdown, LeaderShutdown, serverVars
  <2>4. CASE \E i \in Server : Restart(i)
    BY <2>4, SMTT("r3") DEF AGRoles, Restart, FollowerShutdown, LeaderShutdown, serverVars
  <2>5. CASE \E i, j \in Server : ConnectAndFollowerSendCEPOCH(i, j)
    BY <2>5, SMTT("r3") DEF AGRoles, ConnectAndFollowerSendCEPOCH, serverVars
  <2>6. CASE \E i, j \in Server : LeaderProcessCEPOCH(i, j)
    BY <2>6, SMTT("r3") DEF AGRoles, LeaderProcessCEPOCH, serverVars
  <2>7. CASE \E i, j \in Server : FollowerProcessNEWEPOCH(i, j)
    BY <2>7, SMTT("r3") DEF AGRoles, FollowerProcessNEWEPOCH, FollowerShutdown, serverVars
  <2>8. CASE \E i, j \in Server : LeaderProcessACKEPOCH(i, j)
    BY <2>8, SMTT("r3") DEF AGRoles, LeaderProcessACKEPOCH, serverVars
  <2>9. CASE \E i, j \in Server : FollowerProcessNEWLEADER(i, j)
    BY <2>9, SMTT("r3") DEF AGRoles, FollowerProcessNEWLEADER, FollowerShutdown, serverVars
  <2>10. CASE \E i, j \in Server : LeaderProcessACKLD(i, j)
    BY <2>10, SMTT("r3") DEF AGRoles, LeaderProcessACKLD, serverVars
  <2>11. CASE \E i, j \in Server : FollowerProcessCOMMITLD(i, j)
    BY <2>11, SMTT("r3") DEF AGRoles, FollowerProcessCOMMITLD, serverVars
  <2>12. CASE \E i \in Server : LeaderProcessRequest(i)
    BY <2>12, SMTT("r3") DEF AGRoles, LeaderProcessRequest, serverVars
  <2>13. CASE \E i \in Server : LeaderBroadcastPROPOSE(i)
    BY <2>13, SMTT("r3") DEF AGRoles, LeaderBroadcastPROPOSE, serverVars
  <2>14. CASE \E i, j \in Server : FollowerProcessPROPOSE(i, j)
    BY <2>14, SMTT("r3") DEF AGRoles, FollowerProcessPROPOSE, serverVars
  <2>15. CASE \E i, j \in Server : LeaderProcessACK(i, j)
    BY <2>15, SMTT("r3") DEF AGRoles, LeaderProcessACK, serverVars
  <2>16. CASE \E i, j \in Server : FollowerProcessCOMMIT(i, j)
    BY <2>16, SMTT("r3") DEF AGRoles, FollowerProcessCOMMIT, serverVars
  <2>17. QED BY <2>1, <2>2, <2>3, <2>4, <2>5, <2>6, <2>7,
                    <2>8, <2>9, <2>10, <2>11, <2>12, <2>13,
                    <2>14, <2>15, <2>16 DEF Next
<1>2. ASSUME AGRoles, UNCHANGED vars PROVE AGRoles'
  BY <1>2, SMTT("r1") DEF AGRoles, vars, serverVars
<1>3. QED BY <1>1, <1>2

THEOREM AGRolesInvariant == Spec => []AGRoles
<1>1. Init => AGRoles BY AGRolesInit
<1>2. AGRoles /\ [Next]_vars => AGRoles' BY AGRolesStep
<1>3. QED BY <1>1, <1>2, PTL DEF Spec

LEMMA AGInitialLeadership1 == Init => Leadership1
BY SMTT("r1") DEF Init, InitServerVars, Leadership1, IsLeader,
                       LOOKING, LEADING

LEMMA AGInitialLeadership2 == Init => Leadership2
<1>1. Cardinality({}) = 0
  BY AGFinite!FS_EmptySet, Zenon DEF Cardinality, AGFinite!Cardinality
<1>2. QED BY <1>1, SMTT("r1")
   DEF Init, InitVerifyVars, Leadership2

LEMMA AGInitialPrefix == Init => PrefixConsistency
<1>1. Minimum({1, 1}) = 1
  BY AGMinimumPair, SMTT("r1")
<1>2. QED BY <1>1, AGTxnReflexive, SMTT("r1")
  DEF Init, InitServerVars, PrefixConsistency

LEMMA AGInitialIntegrity == Init => Integrity
BY SMTT("r1") DEF Init, InitServerVars, Integrity, IsFollower,
                       LOOKING, FOLLOWING

LEMMA AGInitialAgreement == Init => Agreement
BY SMTT("r1") DEF Init, InitServerVars, Agreement, IsFollower,
                       LOOKING, FOLLOWING

LEMMA AGInitialTotalOrder == Init => TotalOrder
BY SMTT("r1") DEF Init, InitServerVars, TotalOrder

LEMMA AGInitialLocalOrder == Init => LocalPrimaryOrder
BY SMTT("r1") DEF Init, InitServerVars, LocalPrimaryOrder

LEMMA AGInitialGlobalOrder == Init => GlobalPrimaryOrder
BY SMTT("r1") DEF Init, InitServerVars, GlobalPrimaryOrder

LEMMA AGInitialPrimaryIntegrity == Init => PrimaryIntegrity
BY SMTT("r1") DEF Init, InitServerVars, PrimaryIntegrity, IsLeader,
                       LOOKING, LEADING

AGCommitNatural == \A i \in Server : lastCommitted[i].index \in Nat

AGSharedPrefix ==
    \A i, j \in Server :
      \A k \in (1..lastCommitted[i].index) \cap
                (1..lastCommitted[j].index) :
        TxnEqual(history[i][k], history[j][k])

AGDistinctCommitted ==
    \A i \in Server :
      \A k, l \in 1..lastCommitted[i].index :
        TxnEqual(history[i][k], history[i][l]) => k = l

LEMMA AGPrefixToShared ==
    AGCommitNatural /\ PrefixConsistency => AGSharedPrefix
<1>1. ASSUME AGCommitNatural, PrefixConsistency,
             NEW i \in Server, NEW j \in Server,
             NEW k \in (1..lastCommitted[i].index) \cap
                       (1..lastCommitted[j].index)
      PROVE TxnEqual(history[i][k], history[j][k])
  <2> USE <1>1
  <2>1. DEFINE m == Minimum({lastCommitted[i].index,
                            lastCommitted[j].index})
  <2>2. /\ m \in {lastCommitted[i].index, lastCommitted[j].index}
        /\ m <= lastCommitted[i].index
        /\ m <= lastCommitted[j].index
    BY AGMinimumPair, SMTT("r1") DEF m, AGCommitNatural
  <2>3. m > 0 /\ k \in 1..m
    BY <2>2, SMTT("r1") DEF AGCommitNatural
  <2>4. QED BY <2>3 DEF PrefixConsistency, m
<1>2. QED BY <1>1 DEF AGSharedPrefix

LEMMA AGSharedToPrefix ==
    AGCommitNatural /\ AGSharedPrefix => PrefixConsistency
<1>1. ASSUME AGCommitNatural, AGSharedPrefix,
             NEW i \in Server, NEW j \in Server
      PROVE LET m == Minimum({lastCommitted[i].index,
                               lastCommitted[j].index})
            IN m = 0 \/
               /\ m > 0
               /\ \A k \in 1..m :
                    TxnEqual(history[i][k], history[j][k])
  <2> USE <1>1
  <2>1. DEFINE m == Minimum({lastCommitted[i].index,
                            lastCommitted[j].index})
  <2>2. /\ m \in {lastCommitted[i].index, lastCommitted[j].index}
        /\ m <= lastCommitted[i].index
        /\ m <= lastCommitted[j].index
    BY AGMinimumPair, SMTT("r1") DEF m, AGCommitNatural
  <2>3. QED BY <2>2, SMTT("r1")
    DEF m, AGCommitNatural, AGSharedPrefix
<1>2. QED BY <1>1 DEF PrefixConsistency

LEMMA AGSharedToAgreement ==
    AGCommitNatural /\ AGSharedPrefix => Agreement
<1>1. ASSUME AGCommitNatural, AGSharedPrefix,
             NEW i \in Server, NEW j \in Server,
             NEW k \in 1..lastCommitted[i].index,
             NEW l \in 1..lastCommitted[j].index
      PROVE \/ \E n \in 1..lastCommitted[j].index :
                  TxnEqual(history[j][n], history[i][k])
            \/ \E n \in 1..lastCommitted[i].index :
                  TxnEqual(history[i][n], history[j][l])
  <2> USE <1>1
  <2>1. CASE k <= lastCommitted[j].index
    <3> USE <2>1
    <3>1. k \in 1..lastCommitted[j].index
      BY SMTT("r1") DEF AGCommitNatural
    <3>2. TxnEqual(history[j][k], history[i][k])
      BY <3>1 DEF AGSharedPrefix
    <3>3. QED BY <3>1, <3>2
  <2>2. CASE ~(k <= lastCommitted[j].index)
    <3> USE <2>2
    <3>1. l \in 1..lastCommitted[i].index
      BY SMTT("r1") DEF AGCommitNatural
    <3>2. TxnEqual(history[i][l], history[j][l])
      BY <3>1 DEF AGSharedPrefix
    <3>3. QED BY <3>1, <3>2
  <2>3. QED BY <2>1, <2>2
<1>2. QED BY <1>1 DEF Agreement

LEMMA AGCrossIndex ==
    ASSUME AGCommitNatural, AGSharedPrefix, AGDistinctCommitted,
           NEW i \in Server, NEW j \in Server,
           NEW k \in 1..lastCommitted[i].index,
           NEW l \in 1..lastCommitted[j].index,
           TxnEqual(history[i][k], history[j][l])
    PROVE k = l
<1>1. CASE k <= lastCommitted[j].index
  <2> USE <1>1
  <2>1. k \in 1..lastCommitted[j].index
    BY SMTT("r1") DEF AGCommitNatural
  <2>2. TxnEqual(history[j][k], history[i][k])
    BY <2>1 DEF AGSharedPrefix
  <2>3. TxnEqual(history[j][k], history[j][l])
    BY <2>2, AGTxnTransitive
  <2>4. QED BY <2>1, <2>3 DEF AGDistinctCommitted
<1>2. CASE ~(k <= lastCommitted[j].index)
  <2> USE <1>2
  <2>1. l \in 1..lastCommitted[i].index
    BY SMTT("r1") DEF AGCommitNatural
  <2>2. TxnEqual(history[j][l], history[i][l])
    BY <2>1 DEF AGSharedPrefix
  <2>3. TxnEqual(history[i][k], history[i][l])
    BY <2>2, AGTxnTransitive
  <2>4. QED BY <2>1, <2>3 DEF AGDistinctCommitted
<1>3. QED BY <1>1, <1>2

LEMMA AGSharedToTotalOrder ==
    AGCommitNatural /\ AGSharedPrefix /\ AGDistinctCommitted => TotalOrder
<1>1. ASSUME AGCommitNatural, AGSharedPrefix, AGDistinctCommitted,
             NEW i \in Server, NEW j \in Server,
             lastCommitted[i].index >= 2,
             lastCommitted[j].index >= 2,
             NEW k \in 1..(lastCommitted[i].index - 1),
             NEW l \in (k + 1)..lastCommitted[i].index,
             \E n \in 1..lastCommitted[j].index :
                TxnEqual(history[i][l], history[j][n])
      PROVE \E n \in 1..lastCommitted[j].index :
              /\ TxnEqual(history[i][l], history[j][n])
              /\ \E m \in 1..(n - 1) :
                   TxnEqual(history[i][k], history[j][m])
  <2> USE <1>1
  <2>1. PICK n \in 1..lastCommitted[j].index :
          TxnEqual(history[i][l], history[j][n])
    OBVIOUS
  <2>2. /\ k \in 1..lastCommitted[i].index
        /\ l \in 1..lastCommitted[i].index
        /\ k < l
    BY SMTT("r1") DEF AGCommitNatural
  <2>3. l = n
    BY <2>1, <2>2, AGCrossIndex
  <2>4. /\ k \in 1..lastCommitted[j].index
        /\ k \in 1..(n - 1)
    BY <2>1, <2>2, <2>3, SMTT("r1") DEF AGCommitNatural
  <2>5. TxnEqual(history[i][k], history[j][k])
    BY <2>2, <2>4 DEF AGSharedPrefix
  <2>6. QED BY <2>1, <2>4, <2>5
<1>2. QED BY <1>1 DEF TotalOrder

LEMMA AGInitialShared == Init => AGCommitNatural /\ AGSharedPrefix
BY AGInitialPrefix, AGPrefixToShared, SMTT("r1")
   DEF Init, InitServerVars, AGCommitNatural

LEMMA AGInitialDistinct == Init => AGDistinctCommitted
BY SMTT("r1") DEF Init, InitServerVars, AGDistinctCommitted

AGMapOn(f, D) == f = [i \in D |-> f[i]]

AGServerMaps ==
    /\ AGMapOn(currentEpoch, Server)
    /\ AGMapOn(history, Server)
    /\ AGMapOn(lastCommitted, Server)

LEMMA AGServerMapsInit == Init => AGServerMaps
BY SMTT("r1") DEF Init, InitServerVars, AGServerMaps, AGMapOn

LEMMA AGServerMapsStep == AGServerMaps /\ [Next]_vars => AGServerMaps'
<1>1. ASSUME AGServerMaps, Next PROVE AGServerMaps'
  <2> USE <1>1
  <2>1. CASE \E i \in Server : UpdateLeader(i)
    BY <2>1, SMTT("r3") DEF AGServerMaps, AGMapOn, UpdateLeader, serverVars
  <2>2. CASE \E i \in Server : FollowLeader(i)
    BY <2>2, SMTT("r3") DEF AGServerMaps, AGMapOn, FollowLeader, serverVars
  <2>3. CASE \E i, j \in Server : Timeout(i, j)
    BY <2>3, SMTT("r3") DEF AGServerMaps, AGMapOn, Timeout, serverVars
  <2>4. CASE \E i \in Server : Restart(i)
    BY <2>4, SMTT("r3") DEF AGServerMaps, AGMapOn, Restart, serverVars
  <2>5. CASE \E i, j \in Server : ConnectAndFollowerSendCEPOCH(i, j)
    BY <2>5, SMTT("r3") DEF AGServerMaps, AGMapOn, ConnectAndFollowerSendCEPOCH, serverVars
  <2>6. CASE \E i, j \in Server : LeaderProcessCEPOCH(i, j)
    BY <2>6, SMTT("r3") DEF AGServerMaps, AGMapOn, LeaderProcessCEPOCH, serverVars
  <2>7. CASE \E i, j \in Server : FollowerProcessNEWEPOCH(i, j)
    BY <2>7, SMTT("r3") DEF AGServerMaps, AGMapOn, FollowerProcessNEWEPOCH, serverVars
  <2>8. CASE \E i, j \in Server : LeaderProcessACKEPOCH(i, j)
    BY <2>8, SMTT("r3") DEF AGServerMaps, AGMapOn, LeaderProcessACKEPOCH, serverVars
  <2>9. CASE \E i, j \in Server : FollowerProcessNEWLEADER(i, j)
    BY <2>9, SMTT("r3") DEF AGServerMaps, AGMapOn, FollowerProcessNEWLEADER, serverVars
  <2>10. CASE \E i, j \in Server : LeaderProcessACKLD(i, j)
    BY <2>10, SMTT("r3") DEF AGServerMaps, AGMapOn, LeaderProcessACKLD, serverVars
  <2>11. CASE \E i, j \in Server : FollowerProcessCOMMITLD(i, j)
    BY <2>11, SMTT("r3") DEF AGServerMaps, AGMapOn, FollowerProcessCOMMITLD, serverVars
  <2>12. CASE \E i \in Server : LeaderProcessRequest(i)
    BY <2>12, SMTT("r3") DEF AGServerMaps, AGMapOn, LeaderProcessRequest, serverVars
  <2>13. CASE \E i \in Server : LeaderBroadcastPROPOSE(i)
    BY <2>13, SMTT("r3") DEF AGServerMaps, AGMapOn, LeaderBroadcastPROPOSE, serverVars
  <2>14. CASE \E i, j \in Server : FollowerProcessPROPOSE(i, j)
    BY <2>14, SMTT("r3") DEF AGServerMaps, AGMapOn, FollowerProcessPROPOSE, serverVars
  <2>15. CASE \E i, j \in Server : LeaderProcessACK(i, j)
    BY <2>15, SMTT("r3") DEF AGServerMaps, AGMapOn, LeaderProcessACK, LeaderTryToCommit, serverVars
  <2>16. CASE \E i, j \in Server : FollowerProcessCOMMIT(i, j)
    BY <2>16, SMTT("r3") DEF AGServerMaps, AGMapOn, FollowerProcessCOMMIT, serverVars
  <2>17. QED BY <2>1, <2>2, <2>3, <2>4, <2>5, <2>6, <2>7,
                    <2>8, <2>9, <2>10, <2>11, <2>12, <2>13,
                    <2>14, <2>15, <2>16 DEF Next
<1>2. ASSUME AGServerMaps, UNCHANGED vars PROVE AGServerMaps'
  BY <1>2, SMTT("r1") DEF AGServerMaps, AGMapOn, vars, serverVars
<1>3. QED BY <1>1, <1>2

THEOREM AGServerMapsInvariant == Spec => []AGServerMaps
<1>1. Init => AGServerMaps BY AGServerMapsInit
<1>2. AGServerMaps /\ [Next]_vars => AGServerMaps' BY AGServerMapsStep
<1>3. QED BY <1>1, <1>2, PTL DEF Spec

AGCommittedLogged ==
    \A i \in Server : \A k \in 1..lastCommitted[i].index :
      \E p \in proposalMsgsLog :
        TxnEqual(history[i][k], [zxid |-> p.zxid, value |-> p.data])

LEMMA AGLoggedIntegrity == AGCommittedLogged => Integrity
BY SMTT("r1") DEF AGCommittedLogged, Integrity

LEMMA AGInitialLogged == Init => AGCommittedLogged
<1>1. ASSUME Init, NEW i \in Server,
             NEW k \in 1..lastCommitted[i].index
      PROVE \E p \in proposalMsgsLog :
        TxnEqual(history[i][k], [zxid |-> p.zxid, value |-> p.data])
  <2> USE <1>1
  <2>1. DEFINE p == [source |-> i, epoch |-> 0,
                     zxid |-> BootstrapZxid, data |-> 0]
  <2>2. p \in proposalMsgsLog
    BY SMTT("r1") DEF Init, InitVerifyVars, BootstrapProposalMsgs, p
  <2>3. k = 1 /\ history[i] = <<BootstrapTxn>>
    BY SMTT("r1") DEF Init, InitServerVars
  <2>4. TxnEqual(history[i][k], [zxid |-> p.zxid, value |-> p.data])
    BY <2>3, SMTT("r1") DEF p, BootstrapTxn, TxnEqual, ZxidEqual
  <2>5. QED BY <2>2, <2>4
<1>2. QED BY <1>1 DEF AGCommittedLogged

AGCommittedEpochTypes ==
    \A i \in Server : \A k \in 1..lastCommitted[i].index :
      history[i][k].zxid[1] \in Int /\ history[i][k].zxid[2] \in Int

AGCommittedZxidOrder ==
    \A i \in Server : \A k, l \in 1..lastCommitted[i].index :
      k < l => ZxidCompare(history[i][l].zxid, history[i][k].zxid)

LEMMA AGSortedGlobal ==
    AGCommitNatural /\ AGCommittedEpochTypes /\ AGCommittedZxidOrder
      => GlobalPrimaryOrder
<1>1. ASSUME AGCommitNatural, AGCommittedEpochTypes, AGCommittedZxidOrder,
             NEW i \in Server,
             NEW k \in 1..lastCommitted[i].index,
             NEW l \in 1..lastCommitted[i].index,
             EpochPrecedeInTxn(history[i][k], history[i][l])
      PROVE k < l
  BY <1>1, SMTT("r2") DEF AGCommitNatural, AGCommittedEpochTypes,
                          AGCommittedZxidOrder, EpochPrecedeInTxn, ZxidCompare
<1>2. QED BY <1>1 DEF GlobalPrimaryOrder

LEMMA AGSortedDistinct ==
    AGCommitNatural /\ AGCommittedEpochTypes /\ AGCommittedZxidOrder
      => AGDistinctCommitted
<1>1. ASSUME AGCommitNatural, AGCommittedEpochTypes, AGCommittedZxidOrder,
             NEW i \in Server,
             NEW k \in 1..lastCommitted[i].index,
             NEW l \in 1..lastCommitted[i].index,
             TxnEqual(history[i][k], history[i][l])
      PROVE k = l
  <2> USE <1>1
  <2>1. k \in Int /\ l \in Int
    BY SMTT("r1") DEF AGCommitNatural
  <2>2. ~(k < l)
    BY SMTT("r2") DEF AGCommittedEpochTypes, AGCommittedZxidOrder,
                          ZxidCompare, TxnEqual, ZxidEqual
  <2>3. ~(l < k)
    BY SMTT("r2") DEF AGCommittedEpochTypes, AGCommittedZxidOrder,
                          ZxidCompare, TxnEqual, ZxidEqual
  <2>4. QED BY <2>1, <2>2, <2>3, SMTT("r1")
<1>2. QED BY <1>1 DEF AGDistinctCommitted

LEMMA AGInitialSorted ==
    Init => AGCommitNatural /\ AGCommittedEpochTypes /\ AGCommittedZxidOrder
BY SMTT("r2") DEF Init, InitServerVars, BootstrapTxn, BootstrapZxid,
                  AGCommitNatural, AGCommittedEpochTypes, AGCommittedZxidOrder
\* END AGENT HELPERS

THEOREM Spec => []Leadership1
\* BEGIN AGENT PROOF ZooKeeper/Zab_Leadership1.tla
<1> DEFINE AGInvLeadership1 == AGRoles /\ AGServerMaps /\
                         Leadership1
<1>1. Init => AGInvLeadership1
  BY AGRolesInit, AGServerMapsInit, AGInitialLeadership1, SMTT("r1")
     DEF AGInvLeadership1
<1>2. AGInvLeadership1 /\ [Next]_vars => AGInvLeadership1'
  <2>1. ASSUME AGInvLeadership1, Next PROVE AGInvLeadership1'
    <3> USE <2>1
    <3>1. AGRoles' /\ AGServerMaps'
      BY AGRolesStep, AGServerMapsStep, SMTT("r1") DEF AGInvLeadership1
    <3>2. CASE \E i \in Server : UpdateLeader(i)
      BY <3>2, <3>1, SMTT("r1")
         DEF AGInvLeadership1, AGRoles, AGServerMaps, AGMapOn, IsLeader, IsFollower, LOOKING, FOLLOWING, LEADING, ELECTION, DISCOVERY, SYNCHRONIZATION, BROADCAST, Leadership1,
             UpdateLeader, SwitchToLeader, serverVars, verifyVars
    <3>3. CASE \E i \in Server : FollowLeader(i)
      BY <3>3, <3>1, SMTT("r1")
         DEF AGInvLeadership1, AGRoles, AGServerMaps, AGMapOn, IsLeader, IsFollower, LOOKING, FOLLOWING, LEADING, ELECTION, DISCOVERY, SYNCHRONIZATION, BROADCAST, Leadership1,
             FollowLeader, SwitchToLeader, SwitchToFollower, serverVars, verifyVars
    <3>4. CASE \E i, j \in Server : Timeout(i, j)
      BY <3>4, <3>1, SMTT("r1")
         DEF AGInvLeadership1, AGRoles, AGServerMaps, AGMapOn, IsLeader, IsFollower, LOOKING, FOLLOWING, LEADING, ELECTION, DISCOVERY, SYNCHRONIZATION, BROADCAST, Leadership1,
             Timeout, FollowerShutdown, LeaderShutdown, RemoveLearner, serverVars, verifyVars
    <3>5. CASE \E i \in Server : Restart(i)
      BY <3>5, <3>1, SMTT("r1")
         DEF AGInvLeadership1, AGRoles, AGServerMaps, AGMapOn, IsLeader, IsFollower, LOOKING, FOLLOWING, LEADING, ELECTION, DISCOVERY, SYNCHRONIZATION, BROADCAST, Leadership1,
             Restart, FollowerShutdown, LeaderShutdown, RemoveLearner, serverVars, verifyVars
    <3>6. CASE \E i, j \in Server : ConnectAndFollowerSendCEPOCH(i, j)
      BY <3>6, <3>1, SMTT("r1")
         DEF AGInvLeadership1, AGRoles, AGServerMaps, AGMapOn, IsLeader, IsFollower, LOOKING, FOLLOWING, LEADING, ELECTION, DISCOVERY, SYNCHRONIZATION, BROADCAST, Leadership1,
             ConnectAndFollowerSendCEPOCH, serverVars, verifyVars
    <3>7. CASE \E i, j \in Server : LeaderProcessCEPOCH(i, j)
      BY <3>7, <3>1, SMTT("r1")
